derived.conclusion: The 60 s ceiling is exceeded by pre-kernel stages alone plus any nonzero kernel loop; load is 45.0 s (75%) of the budget.

projection assumes the early uniform kernel rate and control rollup cost

hypotheses.claim: Gen-2 cyclic-GC pauses over the 5.06M-event / ~6 GB live object graph cause both multi-second stalls (event pass 3.586 s; kernel loop >=4.12 s with zero progress).
hypotheses.expected_evidence: gc.callbacks start/stop with generation 2 at t~51.7-53.9 and t~56.3-60.4; gc.freeze() after load removes the stalls and shortens the load stage
hypotheses.falsifier: no gen-2 callback events at those timestamps, or stalls persist with GC frozen

hypotheses.claim: A single kernel near trace index 1.55M has a large candidate/owner set, making the nested innermost any() test (audit.py:99-108) quadratic.
hypotheses.expected_evidence: owner or candidate count spike at that index; a count-only pass reports it without a fix
hypotheses.falsifier: candidate counts stay 1 (fragment shows 1 up to 1.541M) and that index completes quickly under GC freeze

hypotheses.claim: The 60 s ceiling is unreachable for this input without reducing the load/scan cost: pre-kernel stages already take 55.85 s, of which the load is 45.0 s at 49.3 MB/s.
hypotheses.expected_evidence: any run of the frozen load path on this trace stays near 45 s
hypotheses.falsifier: a load-equivalent measurement well below ~40 s

hypotheses.claim: P0 dp0's lane is structurally heavier, not merely larger: 2.75x events, 3.88x calls, 5.24x annotation ranges for 2.13x kernels versus the completed prefill dp1 rank.
hypotheses.expected_evidence: per-unit costs at or above control values, linear extrapolation of prefill dp1's 33.4 s to ~80-95 s
hypotheses.falsifier: per-unit costs equal to the controls (already observed for the event pass and early kernel pass), which would leave the stalls and load as the explanation

hypotheses.claim: The 21 boundary observations did not create the failure.
hypotheses.expected_evidence: identical first kernel index 1386499 in baseline and diagnostic; same row/index ratio; <=~2% inferred wall overhead
hypotheses.falsifier: a recovered baseline pre-kernel time materially below 55.85 s (unrecoverable from the retained fragment)

proposed_next_experiment.status: NOT EXECUTED - requires a separate allocation
proposed_next_experiment.run: one 60 s / 30 G run of this exact instrumented copy on the same input with gc.callbacks start/stop+generation records and gc.freeze() after load, plus the decode-dp1 equivalence control
proposed_next_experiment.discriminates: H1 (uniform progress, shorter load) versus H2 (identical stall at the same index) and H3 (unchanged load cost)

limits: One P0 rank only; the other seven P0 ranks are inferred from near-identical trace sizes, not measured.
No full kernel/loss count and no acceptance of the P0 traces follows from the truncated partial index.
The gzip/JSON split inside the load stage is extrapolated from decode controls.
GC and page-cache state were not instrumented; the diagnostic ran alone while the baseline ran two ranks at a time.
The in-scope cgroup limit file was not captured for this run; the literal MemoryMax=30G argument is recorded and the last observed RSS was 6.26 GB.
No algorithm correction, timeout change, GPU retry, platform operation or GPU admission is part of this record.
